{"candidate": {"code": "    def sanitize_email(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Replace all email addresses with ``[REDACTED_EMAIL]``.

        BUG_65: the regex ``[\w.]+@[\w.]+`` does not include ``+``
        in the local-part character class, so plus-addressed emails
        like ``user+tag@domain.com`` are **not** redacted.
        Should be ``[\w.+]+@[\w.]+``.
        """
        import orgops.compliance
        email_re = re.compile(r"[\w.+]+@[\w.]+")
        count = len(email_re.findall(text))
        result = email_re.sub(_REDACTED_EMAIL, text)
        orgops.compliance.record_decision("pii.sanitized", field_count=count)
        return result", "comments": "Fix email regex to include + for plus-addressed emails and record PII sanitization via orgops.compliance for SOC2 audit compliance."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug65_email_plus_and_compliance", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug65/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Plus-addressed email regex fix AND compliance decision via orgops.compliance.record_decision.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the email regex to include + in the local-part character class (so that user+tag@domain.com is redacted) AND call orgops.compliance.record_decision("pii.sanitized", field_count=count) where count is the number of emails redacted?"}]}
